In a golf tournament, there were five golfers: Dan, Ana, Eli, Mya, and Amy. Amy finished above Eli. Ana finished above Amy. Mya finished below Eli. Dan finished last.
Options:
(A) Dan finished second-to-last
(B) Ana finished second-to-last
(C) Eli finished second-to-last
(D) Mya finished second-to-last
(E) Amy finished second-to-last

The crow is the second from the right. The robin is the second from the left.
Options:
(A) The owl is the second from the right
(B) The hummingbird is the second from the right
(C) The crow is the second from the right
(D) The hawk is the second from the right
(E) The robin is the second from the right
